title: A Promise for the Orchard
author: Rafael Yarrow
blurb: Ivo Okonkwo, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
